entities.name: Ingrid Reichert
entities.description: Young cathar of Innistrad who aided Dack Fayden against Baron Falkenrath and Sifa Grent.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: Planeswalker who arrived on Innistrad and saved Ingrid.

entities.name: Sifa Grent
entities.description: Threat to the town whom Dack and Ingrid opposed.

events.summary: Dack saved Ingrid and peasants from Baron Falkenrath's vampires, and Ingrid returned the favor.
events.quote: his first act was to save Ingrid and some peasants from Baron Eckhart Von Falkenrath

events.summary: Dack and Ingrid fought vampires at the Baron's castle and Dack captured the Baron.
events.quote: Dack used his magic to capture the Baron

events.summary: Ingrid gathered cathars to save Dack and the town from Sifa Grent; Dack planeswalked and she could not follow.
events.quote: he planeswalked and this time she was unable to follow him

relations.quote: she later got a bunch of cathars together to save Dack and the town from Sifa Grent
